deadline.quote: Applications for fall 2027 open on August 1, 2026 and must be submitted through the Graduate School Application Portal. The application deadline is December 1. | Finalize and submit your entire application by December 1, 2026.

app_fee.value: USD 95 Graduate School fee; one fee covers up to two programs
app_fee.quote: The Graduate School application fee is $95.00 and can be paid online after you submit your application.

fee_waiver.value: Internationals only eligible for a discretionary department waiver; Physics grants a small number (rolling from late October), requested by email after submitting and before the deadline
fee_waiver.quote: International students are only eligible to receive a discretionary fee waiver from their department of interest.

also.quote: We have a limited number of fee waivers to grant and they will be granted starting around late October on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: Do not submit GRE; not required and will not be considered
gre_general.quote: Do not submit GRE scores (General nor Subject). They are not required and will not be considered.

gre_physics.value: Do not submit Physics GRE; not required and will not be considered
gre_physics.quote: Do not submit GRE scores (General nor Subject). They are not required and will not be considered.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 89 (Graduate School minimum; departments may require more); Duolingo 130; IELTS varies (7.0 desirable)
toefl_min.quote: The minimum acceptable score on the TOEFL iBT (internet- based test) is 89.

english_waiver.value: Waived if the entire bachelor's was taught in English in a country with multiple official languages including English (India's case), with proof: Registrar/Controller of Examinations MOI letter, or transcript/mark sheet stating English medium. Graduate School summary also lists India among English-language university countries.
english_waiver.quote: The language of instruction was English for the entirety of your bachelor’s degree program and the country has multiple official languages, including English. | An official or attested letter issued by the institution’s Registrar, Controller of Examinations, or equivalent central academic records office confirming that English was the language of instruction for the entirety of the applicant’s degree program.

also.quote: you (will) have an equivalent degree from an English-language university in United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, Nigeria, Ghana, India, New Zealand, and Canada (except Quebec).
